papers.title: MIRA: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Deceptive Contextual Augmentation
papers.alt: MIRA schematic: deceptive context, visual reflection, and robust reasoning through reinforcement learning.
papers.summary: Reinforcement learning with deceptive visual contexts and group-wise reflection triggers, encouraging multimodal models to revisit perceptual mistakes and recover during reasoning.
papers.details: MIRA first generates and filters misleading visual descriptions, then injects them into training contexts. Reflection triggers within rollout groups encourage visual self-correction while mixing in original data to preserve generalization.

papers.title: FREAK: A Fine-grained Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Advanced MLLMs
papers.alt: FREAK research schematic showing fine-grained counter-commonsense edits and hallucination evaluation.
papers.summary: A benchmark built from photorealistic images with fine-grained counter-commonsense edits, probing whether advanced multimodal models perceive visual details or fall back on familiar priors.
papers.details: FREAK evaluates fine-grained visual hallucination using edited photorealistic images and a controlled subset for detailed perception analysis. It also investigates the behavior of Chain-of-Thought prompting in this setting.

papers.title: Veto: A Training-free Framework for Fine-grained Visual Perception via Iterative Negative Filtering
papers.alt: Veto research schematic showing iterative removal of distracting regions and verification of visual grounding.
papers.summary: A training-free perception framework that progressively removes distracting image regions, helping vision-language models locate and verify fine-grained visual evidence.
papers.details: Veto uses reasoning-driven negative filtering to narrow the visual field, followed by verifiable visual grounding. The framework operates at inference time and targets detail-sensitive perception in complex, high-resolution scenes.

papers.title: ModalSearcher: Weaving Visual Evidence into Autonomous Cross-Modal Deep Search
papers.alt: A winding search path alternates between text and image evidence.
papers.summary: An autonomous cross-modal search agent that gathers and combines text and image evidence across multiple hops, choosing search modalities as its information needs evolve.
papers.details: ModalSearch-Pipeline constructs interleaved multimodal knowledge graphs and synthesizes multi-hop questions. ModalSearcher learns to use text search, image search, reverse-image search, and URL reading through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in a live Web environment. ModalSearch-Bench evaluates autonomous modality selection and cross-modal evidence integration.
